source.result: Tobias Niedziella, 8th place, Regional Frankfurt (26 Sep 2026). The best Nice result was 132nd, so this earlier Top 8 list was used instead.
source.note: A real tournament list. card_text entries are short quotes from data/; see the full text there.

requirements: Real tournament list: Mega Lopunny ex hits for 230 with 1 Energy whenever it moved from the Bench to the Active Spot that turn, so the deck switches constantly, with Dusknoir for extra damage counters and a toolbox of Basic attackers.

strategy: Get Mega Lopunny ex onto the Bench (Salvatore can do it on your first turn when going second), then switch it into the Active Spot with Switch or a pivoting attacker so its 1-Energy attack does 230. Dusclops and Dusknoir add 5 or 13 damage counters to finish 300+ HP Pokémon or Benched targets. Mega Kangaskhan ex draws while Active and is a second big attacker, and a box of Basics (Mew ex, Bloodmoon Ursaluna ex, Clefairy, Bronzong, Frillish) covers special situations. Lopunny and Kangaskhan only need Colorless Energy, so the deck plays very little Energy.

main_resource.resource: Turns on which Mega Lopunny ex moves from the Bench to the Active Spot before attacking
main_resource.formula: Gale Thrust: 60 + 170 = 230 for 1 Colorless, only if it moved in this turn. Without the move, Gale Thrust is 60 and Spiky Hopper is 160 for 2. Dusknoir adds 130 (360 total), Dusclops adds 50 (280), both 410. Mega Lopunny ex has 330 HP and the deck plays only 6 Energy.

card_text: Mega Lopunny ex: "If this Pokémon moved from your Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does 170 more damage."
Switch: "Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon."
Latias ex: "Your Basic Pokémon in play have no Retreat Cost."
Mega Kangaskhan ex: "Draw 2 cards."
Buneary: "Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon."
synergies.how_they_interact: The whole deck exists to meet one condition. Two ways make it true on the turn you attack: the Switch card (4 copies), or retreating the Active Basic and promoting Lopunny. Latias ex makes that retreat free for every Basic, so Kangaskhan can use Run Errand (draw 2), retreat for nothing, and Lopunny comes in for Gale Thrust (230 for 1 Energy). Mew ex has Retreat 0, so it does the same with no Latias. Limit: Buneary's Run Around and Mew ex's Teleportation Burst are attacks, which end the turn, so the Lopunny they promote does not get the bonus until it leaves and comes back. Lopunny is a Stage 1, so Latias's free retreat is for the Basics around it, not for Lopunny.

card_text: Dusknoir: "you may put 13 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If you use this Ability, this Pokémon is Knocked Out."
Dusclops: "you may put 5 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon"
Rare Candy: "If you have a Stage 2 card in your hand that evolves from that Pokémon, put that card onto the Basic Pokémon to evolve it, skipping the Stage 1."
Duskull: "Put up to 3 Duskull from your discard pile onto your Bench."
synergies.how_they_interact: 230 does not Knock Out a Pokémon ex with 300 or more HP. Dusknoir adds 130 on any Pokémon: 230 + 130 = 360, and Dusclops 230 + 50 = 280, so a Lopunny turn can finish a 340 HP Pokémon, or Dusknoir takes a separate Benched Knock Out in the same turn. Rare Candy puts Dusknoir out of Duskull (3 copies each of Duskull, Dusknoir, 3 Rare Candy), Boss's Orders pulls a damaged target forward, and each self-KO gives up only 1 Prize. Night Stretcher and Duskull's Come and Get You bring the line back from the discard pile.

card_text: Salvatore: "Search your deck for a card that has no Abilities and evolves from 1 of your Pokémon, and put it onto that Pokémon to evolve it."
Hilda: "Search your deck for an Evolution Pokémon and an Energy card"
Buddy-Buddy Poffin: "Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon with 70 HP or less"
Telepathic Psychic Energy: "search your deck for up to 2 Basic {P} Pokémon and put them onto your Bench"
Meowth ex: "Search your deck for a Supporter card"
synergies.how_they_interact: Mega Lopunny ex has no Ability, so Salvatore can evolve a Benched Buneary straight from the deck, even on your first turn going second. That needs a Buneary in play, and there are only 2, so the other outs matter: Poffin (Buneary has 70 HP), 4 Poké Pad, 3 Ultra Ball. Hilda finds Lopunny and an Energy as the other route. Telepathic Psychic Energy benches 2 Psychic Basics (Duskull, Mew ex, Bronzor, Frillish) and Meowth ex finds Salvatore or Hilda. Limit: Dusclops and Dusknoir have Abilities, so Salvatore can't fetch them; Rare Candy and Hilda do.

card_text: Ciphermaniac's Codebreaking: "Search your deck for 2 cards, shuffle your deck, then put those cards on top of it in any order."
Enriching Energy: "When you attach this card from your hand to a Pokémon, draw 4 cards."
Lillie's Determination: "draw 6 cards. If you have exactly 6 Prize cards remaining, draw 8 cards instead."
synergies.how_they_interact: Switch is 4 cards in 60, and only Ciphermaniac's Codebreaking can search one out, so finding it is the weak point. Ciphermaniac's puts Switch and the next card on top, and Mega Kangaskhan ex's Run Errand draws exactly those 2 the same turn. Enriching Energy draws 4 when it is attached (it provides Colorless, which pays for Gale Thrust), and Lillie's Determination refills a spent hand. Play the draw cards before deciding between the Switch and the retreat route.

card_text: Frillish: "they can't play any Item cards from their hand"
Bronzong: "they can't play any Pokémon from their hand to evolve their Pokémon"
Jamming Tower: "Pokémon Tools attached to each Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) have no effect."
Special Red Card: "You can use this card only if your opponent has 3 or fewer Prize cards remaining."
Bloodmoon Ursaluna ex: "Blood Moon used by this Pokémon costs {C} less for each Prize card your opponent has taken."
synergies.how_they_interact: The toolbox covers matchups Lopunny cannot. Frillish stops Items for a turn, Bronzong stops evolving from hand (a Stage 2 deck's setup), Jamming Tower turns off the opponent's Tools, and Special Red Card resets a full hand when they are near the end. Lillie's Clefairy ex turns Dragon Pokémon weak to Psychic, and Bloodmoon Ursaluna ex hits for 240 and gets cheaper with each Prize the opponent takes (1 Energy at 4 Prizes). These Pokémon are Basics, so Latias ex's free retreat applies to them.
